Welcome to Today's Lesson!

Let’s play hide-and-seek in Tibetan!
Today, we are learning a special "Where Word" to show where things are hiding:
སྒང་ལ། (gang la) = on / on top of

In Tibetan, this word goes at the end—like a tail!
དེབ་ འདི་ ཅོག་ཙེའི་ སྒང་ལ་ འདུག
Look at the words below, say them out loud, and get ready to act them out!
